basic_details.job_title: VNSGU Office Superintendent Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Veer Narmad South Gujarat University (VNSGU), Surat, has invited applications for the post of Office Superintendent under Advt No. GAD/EmpNotice/25557/2026. The online application is open from 29 October 2026 to 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from any recognized Institute/ University. Experience: Minimum 05 years administrative experience as Head Clerk (Class-III) or equivalent OR 10 years as Senior Clerk (Class-III) or equivalent OR 15 years as Junior Clerk (Class-III) or equivalent in Government, Semi-Government, Local Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings, Grant-in-aid institutions, Private University or Self-financed college. Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on last date of accepting online application) Age relaxation: Socially and Educationally Backward Class / Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe / Economically Weaker Section of Gujarat 5 years (maximum up to 45 years), Women candidates 5 years (maximum up to 45 years), SEBC/SC/ST women candidates 10 years (maximum up to 45 years), Differently-abled candidates 10 years (maximum up to 45 years), Ex-servicemen 5 years (maximum up to 45 years) Other conditions: Basic knowledge of computer use as per Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment Rules, 1967 Working knowledge of both Gujarati and Hindi

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for VNSGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates with degrees or diplomas from institutions declared fake or derecognised. Candidates whose application is incomplete. Reserved category candidates from outside Gujarat cannot claim reservation benefit.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post is sanctioned only for the current financial year; continuation is subject to Government of Gujarat approval and renewal. Fixed salary of Rs. 49,600 per month for the first five years.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online. Last date to pay the fee: 30 November 2026.

rows.category: SEBC, EWS, SC, ST, Ex-servicemen, Differently-abled

content_sections.heading: How Will VNSGU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Preliminary Exam (Screening Test) Main Exam Document Verification Final Merit List based on Main Exam marks Preliminary Exam is for screening only, marks will not be counted in final merit Candidates obtaining 40% or more in Preliminary Exam are eligible for Main Exam Main Exam carries 150 marks

content_sections.heading: VNSGU Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) and Optical Mark Reader (OMR) method 0.25 negative marking for wrong answers

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested testimonials Certificates All supporting documents Caste/Category certificate Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for SEBC candidates School leaving certificate for age proof

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNSGU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online on or before 30-11-2026 till 11:59 pm at http://vnsgunt.samarth.edu.in. Upload necessary documents with the online application. Send two hard copies of the printout of the application along with necessary certificates and testimonials in two sets by Speed Post/Registered Ad/In person to The Registrar, Veer Narmad South Gujarat University, Surat on or before 08-12-2026 till 6:10 pm.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates already in service should apply through their present employer or send an advance copy with fee Application fee is non-refundable
